description:
The image shows a close-up view of a car's interior, specifically the center console and armrests. The center console is located between the front seats and features a black leather or plastic material with a textured pattern. It has a rounded shape with a flat top and bottom, and a curved side that fits snugly against the armrests.

The armrests are attached to the center console and are also made of black leather or plastic. They have a similar rounded shape to the center console
